maddeler.e:
أتهاتف (form VI)
# أَتَهَاتَفُ (ʔatahātafu) /ʔa.ta.haː.ta.fu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of تَهَاتَفَ (tahātafa)
# أَتَهَاتَفَ (ʔatahātafa) /ʔa.ta.haː.ta.fa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of تَهَاتَفَ (tahātafa)
# أَتَهَاتَفْ (ʔatahātaf) /ʔa.ta.haː.taf/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of تَهَاتَفَ (tahātafa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
